rationale: First full-7-fold torch_mitra (iter #2333) completes in ~7 min at fine_tune=False/ctx=4096/support=1024 (vs #2307 25-min first-fold timeout). 0/7 wp but avg_ann +78.9% with W6 +435.1% and W7 +106.1% (both thr=0.0) — the mixture-of-random-classifiers prior finds fat-tail magnitude. Train mode should sweep ctx_subsample ∈ {2048, 4096, 8192}, n_estimators ∈ {1, 3}, fine_tune=True with fine_tune_steps ≤ 10, seed ∈ {7, 13, 17, 23} — with fine_tune=False as the safety floor — to lift WR vs regime-aware floors (especially W5) without re-opening the per-fold wall-time blocker.
